description: This file contains a migration class 'InitialModel' that defines the database schema for the eShopWeb application. It includes creation of sequences, tables for baskets, catalog items, orders, and related entities, as well as index definitions. The class also supports schema rollback in the Down method.

classes.name: InitialModel
classes.description: A Migration class defining the initial database schema for the eShopWeb infrastructure.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply the migration, creating sequences, tables, constraints, and indexes.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines rollback operations, dropping tables and sequences to revert the database to the previous state.
